svg.title: Step 4 polish 05: the storyboard builder at 1280 px
svg.text: 05 · The storyboard builder (desktop, 1280 px)
Mockup 18 redrawn in the dark shell: rounds on a timeline, the round as a strip of steps with the step’s form beside it, the live preview with scrub. Book shots O20–O23.

g.text: A tournament or ceremony item starts
the Pulse and other moments between rounds
Finale: It’s on! · 8 s · Tournament starts
Fills with: Demo Cup, final · Stage · 05:00
Orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Grand final on stage tonight
Airtime on the hero, Main hall
3 of 6 · 2 rounds sound, and the finale
Every round ends: the item starts
By hand has no item: the place reads
Countdown 20 s ≥ 9 s for its words

svg.text: What changed and why
Test-fire and Save in the header
They stay in reach while the page scrolls.
After a test-fire the header says “One test
round on Main hall · marked as a test in
History” (O23).
Triggers and conditions as chip rows
Each trigger and condition is a chip that
opens its own small form; labels sit in one
column at the left. O20 listed them in prose
above a long column of raw fields.
The rounds on a timeline
The rounds are blocks on a time axis from
T−15 to the finale, with the gaps between
them. Set times or every few minutes (a loop,
O21) is one switch; Until and Sound sit on
the same line.
The round as a strip of steps
Each step is a small picture of itself, drawn
in the hero’s look, with its seconds; the
repeat is a bracket; drag to reorder. O20 had
the round only in words.
The selected step’s form beside it
Click a step, and its form opens beside the
strip.
Fields on a grid
Two even columns with a label above each
field; a field is as wide as its content
needs; seconds is a slider, hero or full
screen a switch. O20 had one full-width box
per field (the PO: “one long edit box”).
The live preview with scrub
The real player at the size of a card, with
the step under the playhead; the scrub bar is
coloured by step. O20’s preview was a
thumbnail.
The checks before saving
Airtime and sound budget as bars with their
cap; each check is a sentence with a tick or
a warning, as in O20, now in the same column
as the preview.
